When wild animals get into trouble, help can come from the most unexpected place. Ernie Brown answers the call alongside Neal James, taking on wildlife rescue missions that demand quick instincts and plenty of nerve. From elusive critters hiding in awkward spots to stubborn animals that refuse to be caught, every call brings a new challenge.
Watch Call of the Wildman, Season 1, Episodes 16, 18, 1, 13, 6, 29, 16 and 19, on Animal Planet India.
